stations.title: visits
stations.text: Every visit with its date, written as text.

captions: Rosamund does the accounts on Fridays and needs the month's visits for her report.
Writing a long chain of conditions for every day of a month is slow and easy to get wrong.
You test lists, patterns and ranges with IN, LIKE and BETWEEN, in four tasks.
Now one short condition picks out the month's visits, first and last day included.
Same records, shorter questions. The report is ready before the kettle boils.
